definitions.gloss: end, tail end, last part, conclusion
definitions.explanation: The very end or final portion of a document, list, sequence, or other ordered item. Often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.english: To put a period at the end of a sentence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末尾|まつび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追加|ついか}した→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧。
examples.english: I added a name at the end of the roster.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末尾|まつび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}{文献|ぶんけん}→参考文献：09288_sankoubunken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: A list of references is included at the end of the report, so please check it.

notes:
USAGE:
{末尾|まつび} is a somewhat formal or written term. In everyday speech, ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧ (last, end) is more common. {末尾|まつび} specifically implies the spatial or sequential end of something, rather than the temporal end.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {末尾|まつび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追加|ついか}する→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧: to add at the end
- {末尾|まつび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to note at the end
- ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末尾|まつび}: end of a sentence
- ⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末尾|まつび}: end of the list

SIMILAR WORDS:
{末尾|まつび} (end/tail of a document or sequence) vs. ⟦{冒頭|ぼうとう}→冒頭：11725_boutou⟧ (beginning/opening of a text). These are commonly paired as opposites in written Japanese.
